title: What It Actually Looks Like to Be Single Without Waiting on Anyone
caption:
A godly man is single without being on hold.

Build instead of auditioning. Stop scanning rooms. Be useful where you are. Let God set the clock.

Psalm 27:14: wait for the Lord; be strong, and let your heart take courage.

What are you building while you wait?

#faith #godlymen #christianman #singleness #purpose #trustgod
theme: He chases God, not a wife.
